_template_notes.purpose: Business workflow graph — Discovery #3. Workflows end-to-end + state transitions + sequencing. Source: CQRS Commands/Handlers + state machines + saga orchestrators. Engine #2 + #3.
populate: workflows[]: 1 entry per workflow — {id, name (vd order-to-cash, customer-onboarding), start_state, end_states[], modules_involved[]}
workflows[].transitions[]: state machine — {from_state, to_state, trigger, command|event, guard?, side_effects[]}
workflows[].entry_points[]: API endpoints hoặc UI flows kick off workflow
workflows[].dependencies[]: external workflows phải hoàn thành trước (vd order phải có customer)
metadata.incomplete_workflows: workflows không tìm thấy end state (broken)
